posts.text:
Forget ghosts.
These are the phrases that should make an owner nervous:

"Engagement is up." Up from what, and did it lead anywhere?
"We're optimizing." What changed, and when?
"It's the algorithm." Sometimes. What did you try next?
"Results may vary." Varied how, compared to what?

None of these are wrong on their own. They just need a follow-up question every time.

Happy Halloween from The SocialDM.

Which one have you heard lately?

#Multifamily #PropertyManagement #Halloween

posts.text:
A renter question most communities hear sooner or later: which utilities are included?

Before: "Please contact the leasing office for details."
After: "Water, sewer and trash are one flat monthly fee. Electric and internet go in your name. Ask us for the current amount."

The after answer lets a renter keep comparing without waiting for the office to open. The before answer often means they move on to the next listing.

Who on your team owns the FAQ, and how often does it get a fresh look?

If you had to hunt for it, an AI assistant probably won't find it either. And when an assistant can't find an answer, it tends to recommend a community where it can.

posts.text:
Renters check the date on your photos.
Maybe not on purpose, but they notice.

A pool shot taken in summer, a holiday wreath in April, a model unit with furniture the office replaced two years ago. Each one was fine once. Together they quietly tell a renter nobody is paying attention.

Fresh photos are one of the easiest signals to control:

• Add a few new ones every month, in the season you're in
• Retire anything that no longer matches what a renter will see on a tour
• Keep the same photos on Google, the website and the listing sites

We run every channel from one plan for that reason. The pieces work better when they talk to each other.

A lease up starts with no track record and no search history, so Google and AI assistants have little to say about it at first. Building that presence early matters: a complete Google Business Profile, fresh photos, real answers to renter questions and a reply to every review, kept consistent everywhere renters look.
